1) Effective 1st October 2025, a 6% SST will be imposed on all fees (except the Mobility Fee & Personal Bond) for international students.
2) Fees required by Education Malaysia Global Services (EMGS) from RM3,400 - RM3,550 (For Processing fee, Medical Screening, Insurance, Multiple Visa and ID Card) depending on the country is chargeable separately from the Tuition Fee.
3) A Security Bond Fee, ranging from RM200 to RM2000 depending on nationality, is imposed by Immigration Malaysia. This fee is refundable, provided that all outstanding payments are cleared and the Student Pass cancellation is completed in compliance with the required procedures.
4) The Application Fee & Registration Fee are STRICTLY NON-TRANSFERABLE AND NON-REFUNDABLE once the offer has been accepted.
5) First year Tuition Fee payments made are NON-REFUNDABLE except if the student visa is refused by EMGS/Immigration. All Fees paid are NON-REFUNDABLE under any circumstances once the visa is approved or after the student has commenced studies at any level.
6) The 1st year fees must be paid BEFORE students arrive in Malaysia. Failing to do so, students would have to return to their home country.
7) Any scholarships or bursaries are only applicable if the student completes the programme with UM-Wales.
8) All fees are payable in Malaysian Ringgit (RM). Any shortfall arising from foreign exchange currency transaction to Ringgit Malaysia and bank charges will be borne by the students.
9) Post-dated cheques are not accepted.
13) A Resource and Extension Fee will be applicable for each additional semester that exceeds the duration outlined in the approved program structure.
